pages.text: Iron's Spellbooks is the $(t1)Tier 1$(end) spellcasting system. Spell books, mana, and magic combat from the start.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) First-available magic combat. Spell books can be found in Overworld dungeons. The Dead King, Fire Boss, and Citadel Keeper are T2–$(t3)T3$(end) boss encounters from this mod.$(br2)$(bold)Battlemage synergy:$(/bold) Iron's Spellbooks is the primary mod for the Battlemage class. Mana Barrier and Arcane Infusion passives directly interact with ISS mana.

$(bold)Spellcasting schools:$(/bold) Fire, Ice, Lightning, Poison, Blood, Eldritch, Holy, Ender, Nature. Not all schools are immediately accessible — higher-level books require finding them in dungeons.$(br2)$(bold)Mini-bosses:$(/bold) Archevoker, Cryomancer, Necromancer, and Pyromancer spawn in Overworld structures. They drop $(t2)T2$(end) token peeks and spell books.
Craft the $(bold)Arcane Compendium$(/bold) for the full Iron's Spellbooks reference — spell scrolls, upgrade paths, and school breakdowns.
